structuredContent.body:
Adds a pure, currently unwired local settings patch parser for Refs #3720. It accepts explicit changes/unsets with matching touched-field versions, validates the closed descriptive origin, UUIDs/counters and UTF-16 bounds, rejects non-data/extra-key inputs, and returns detached typed data. It changes no existing settings or transport flow.

Validation on exact source `b908917305eaea9d2b8a11030e2361830b1478b9`:
- 112/112 tests, full TypeScript check, targeted ESLint and base-to-head diff check passed.
- Eight sealed safeguard mutants failed on assertions; byte-restored source passed 112/112 again.
- [Independent exact-source QA approval](https://github.com/Agent-Clubhouse/Clubhouse/blob/a57962fd466978af6b9d4e3aa0b7b34c5f1297f6/docs/qa-transfer/2026-11-20/reports/3720-parser-b90891730-review.md) and [immutable evidence](https://github.com/Agent-Clubhouse/Clubhouse/tree/a95c48b9d6a77a0e61988a4393684b643d0f0f75/docs/implementation-notes/3720-local-settings-parser) retain 40 seals, 29 command receipts and every historical failure.
- Historical missing-API red ran zero tests; the initial 109-test run used an untracked implementation and is historical only. The ES2020 type failure and the later reproduced reflection-error failure are preserved separately from final proof.

Output is detached, **not frozen or immutable**. Future admission consumers must separately capture/freeze requests and enforce sender/grant, current epoch and conflict checks. Direct descriptor/accessor/Proxy tests do not establish Electron IPC reachability. No IPC/admission, persistence, emergency/recovery, name convergence, mixed-version transport, runtime readiness, live or release acceptance is claimed. Hosted CI on this exact PR head remains required.
